blocks.en: Section 2: Biological Tests & Packaging System Evaluation

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 〈87〉 體外生物反應性試驗和 〈88〉 體內試驗的關係，以及 Type I/II 組件的選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the relationship between the <87> in vitro biological reactivity tests and the <88> in vivo tests, and the selection logic for Type I/II components

blocks.zh: 掌握功能適用性三項試驗（穿刺性、碎屑測試、自密封性）的程序要求與接受標準
blocks.en: Master the procedural requirements and acceptance criteria of the three functionality tests (penetrability, fragmentation and self-sealing capacity)

blocks.zh: 能夠解釋 21 gauge、bevel angle 12±2° 針頭規格與橡膠塞穿刺測試的關聯
blocks.en: Be able to explain how the 21 gauge needle with a bevel angle of 12±2° relates to the stopper penetrability test

blocks.zh: 了解生物反應性測試「基線信息」的局限性，以及為何需要與監管機構溝通產品特定適用性
blocks.en: Understand the limitations of the "baseline information" provided by biological reactivity testing, and why product-specific suitability needs to be discussed with regulators

blocks.zh: 4.1 Biological Reactivity — 生物反應性
blocks.en: 4.1 Biological Reactivity

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 〈87〉 體外生物反應性試驗 (In Vitro Biological Reactivity)：使用細胞培養方法（如 MEM Elution, Agar Diffusion, Direct Contact）測試萃取液的細胞毒性（cytotoxicity）。體外試驗快速、成本低，是首選方法。
blocks.en: <87> In Vitro Biological Reactivity: uses cell culture methods (such as MEM Elution, Agar Diffusion and Direct Contact) to test the extract for cytotoxicity. In vitro tests are fast and inexpensive, and are the preferred method.

blocks.zh: 〈88〉 體內生物反應性試驗 (In Vivo Biological Reactivity)：當體外試驗不符合要求時，可改用小鼠（全身注射試驗）或兔子（皮內注射試驗）的體內試驗作為補充。符合 〈87〉 則不需要 〈88〉。
blocks.en: <88> In Vivo Biological Reactivity: when the in vitro test does not meet the requirements, in vivo tests in mice (systemic injection test) or rabbits (intracutaneous test) can be used as a supplement. If <87> is met, <88> is not required.

blocks.zh: 這個「先體外，不過再體內」的邏輯符合 3Rs 原則（Replace, Reduce, Refine）——盡量減少動物試驗。
blocks.en: This logic of "in vitro first, in vivo only if it fails" is consistent with the 3Rs principle (Replace, Reduce, Refine), minimizing animal testing.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 腳注 1 是一個非常重要的監管聲明：〈381〉 的生物反應性測試只提供「基線信息（baseline information）」，通常不足以滿足監管機構的最終適用性要求。這意味著：
blocks.en: Footnote 1 is a very important regulatory statement: the biological reactivity tests in <381> provide only "baseline information" and are generally not sufficient to meet the final suitability requirements of regulators. This means:

blocks.zh: 通過 〈87〉/〈88〉 測試 ≠ 監管批准
blocks.en: Passing the <87>/<88> tests ≠ regulatory approval

blocks.zh: 特別是對於新型生物製劑、高敏感性製劑，還需要進行完整的 〈1663〉/〈1664〉 研究
blocks.en: In particular, for novel biologics and highly sensitive formulations, full <1663>/<1664> studies are also required

blocks.zh: 必須主動與監管機構（FDA、EMA）溝通，確認特定產品的要求
blocks.en: You must proactively consult regulators (FDA, EMA) to confirm the requirements for your specific product

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 生物反應性測試就像餐廳的食材衛生基礎檢查——通過衛生局基本檢查（〈87〉/〈88〉），只說明食材沒有明顯毒素，但這不代表它適合供應給有特殊飲食需求的客人（如過敏、特殊藥物）。針對特定患者（高風險藥品），還需要額外的深度評估（〈1663〉/〈1664〉）。基線就是最低門檻，不是終點。
blocks.en: Biological reactivity testing is like a restaurant's basic ingredient hygiene inspection. Passing the health department's basic inspection (<87>/<88>) only shows that the ingredients contain no obvious toxins; it does not mean they are suitable for guests with special dietary needs (such as allergies or special medications). For specific patients (high-risk drug products), an additional in-depth assessment (<1663>/<1664>) is needed. The baseline is the minimum threshold, not the finish line.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 廠承接一個 mRNA 疫苗客戶，要使用含氟聚合物塗層的橡膠塞。即使供應商提供了符合 〈87〉 的測試報告，你仍需要：（1）要求供應商提供特定批次的 CoA；（2）評估 〈1663〉 可萃取物研究是否已針對 mRNA 製劑的特殊條件（如低溫儲存、pH 範圍）執行；（3）在 CMC 模塊中向 FDA 說明包材選擇的完整科學依據。
blocks.en: A CDMO takes on an mRNA vaccine client who will use fluoropolymer-coated stoppers. Even if the supplier provides a test report showing compliance with <87>, you still need to: (1) require the supplier to provide a CoA for the specific batch; (2) assess whether the <1663> extractables study has been performed under the special conditions of the mRNA formulation (such as low-temperature storage and pH range); and (3) set out in the CMC module for FDA the complete scientific rationale for the packaging selection.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Type I 和 Type II 橡膠塞都需要生物反應性測試？Type II 允許更多的化學萃取物，為何它的生物安全標準和 Type I 一樣？
blocks.en: Why do both Type I and Type II stoppers need biological reactivity testing? Type II allows more chemical extractables, so why is its biological safety standard the same as Type I?

blocks.zh: 一個橡膠塞通過了 〈87〉 細胞毒性試驗，但你的 CDMO 客戶的藥品是一種蛋白抗體。〈87〉 結果是否足夠支持這個應用？
blocks.en: A stopper passes the <87> cytotoxicity test, but your CDMO client's drug product is a protein antibody. Are the <87> results sufficient to support this application?

blocks.zh: 4.3 Functionality Tests — 功能適用性試驗
blocks.en: 4.3 Functionality Tests

blocks.zh: 4.3.1 Penetrability（穿刺性）
blocks.en: 4.3.1 Penetrability

blocks.zh: 4.3.2 Fragmentation（碎屑測試）
blocks.en: 4.3.2 Fragmentation

blocks.zh: 4.3.3 Self-Sealing Capacity（自密封性）
blocks.en: 4.3.3 Self-Sealing Capacity

blocks.zh: 三項功能試驗的目的：
blocks.en: Purpose of the three functionality tests:

blocks.zh: Penetrability（穿刺性）：確保護士/藥師能夠輕鬆穿刺橡膠塞，過緊的塞子會導致操作困難、針頭偏斜，甚至增加針刺傷風險。≤10 N（約 1 kg）的力度確保安全操作性。
blocks.en: Penetrability: ensures that nurses/pharmacists can pierce the stopper easily; a stopper that is too tight makes handling difficult, deflects the needle, and even increases the risk of needle-stick injury. A force of ≤10 N (about 1 kg) ensures safe handling.

blocks.zh: Fragmentation（碎屑測試）：每次穿刺都可能切削下橡膠碎屑，這些碎屑進入藥液是嚴重的可見/不可見異物污染問題。≤5 碎屑的標準是保護患者的底線。
blocks.en: Fragmentation: every puncture can cut off rubber fragments, and fragments entering the drug solution are a serious visible/subvisible particulate contamination problem. The criterion of ≤5 fragments is the bottom line for patient protection.

blocks.zh: Self-Sealing Capacity（自密封性）：多劑量容器（multi-dose containers）被多次穿刺後，橡膠必須能「自動閉合」防止細菌進入。亞甲藍（methylene blue）的藍色是非常靈敏的洩漏指示劑。
blocks.en: Self-Sealing Capacity: after repeated punctures of multi-dose containers, the rubber must be able to "close automatically" to keep bacteria out. The blue color of methylene blue is a very sensitive leak indicator.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula — 碎屑試驗設計邏輯
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation: Design Logic of the Fragmentation Test

blocks.zh:
12 個西林瓶 × 5 次穿刺 = 60 次穿刺總計

每次穿刺在不同位置（different site）
→ 確保測試完整的瓶塞表面，
  而非集中在同一弱點

所有 12 瓶液體合併過濾（single filter）
→ 最大化碎屑收集效率

接受標準：≤5 碎屑（可見，>50 µm）
→ 若有疑義，顯微鏡確認材質和尺寸

注意：液體製劑需浸泡 16 小時
（模擬儲存期間的液體接觸效果）
blocks.en:
12 vials × 5 punctures = 60 punctures in total

Each puncture at a different site
→ ensures the whole stopper surface is tested,
  rather than concentrating on one weak point

Liquid from all 12 vials is pooled and filtered (single filter)
→ maximizes fragment collection efficiency

Acceptance criterion: ≤5 fragments (visible, >50 µm)
→ if in doubt, confirm material and size under a microscope

Note: liquid formulations must be soaked for 16 hours
(simulating liquid contact during storage)

blocks.zh: 針頭規格的標準化意義：21 gauge、bevel angle 12±2° 是標準化試驗條件，確保不同實驗室的結果可比較。臨床上使用的針頭規格千變萬化（18G 到 27G），但測試用 21G 是通過科學研究選定的「代表性最壞情況」規格。在實際產品設計中，如果預期使用更大直徑的針頭（如 18G 用於黏稠藥品），可能需要額外測試。
blocks.en: Significance of standardizing the needle specification: 21 gauge with a bevel angle of 12±2° are standardized test conditions that make results comparable between laboratories. The needles used clinically vary widely (18G to 27G), but 21G was selected through scientific study as the "representative worst-case" size for testing. In actual product design, if a larger-diameter needle is expected (such as 18G for viscous drug products), additional testing may be needed.

blocks.zh: 自密封試驗的 27 kPa 負壓：模擬臨床取藥時注射器抽取藥液造成的瓶內負壓，這是最容易導致外部液體（包含細菌）被吸入的時機。如果橡膠在負壓條件下密封失效，外部的亞甲藍水溶液就會被吸入瓶內——這就是試驗的模擬邏輯。
blocks.en: The 27 kPa negative pressure in the self-sealing test: simulates the negative pressure inside the vial when a syringe withdraws the drug solution clinically, which is the moment when external liquid (including bacteria) is most likely to be drawn in. If the rubber seal fails under negative pressure, the external methylene blue solution will be drawn into the vial, which is the simulation logic of the test.

blocks.zh: 自密封試驗就像測試游泳圈（橡膠）被刺破多次後是否還能防水——你用針刺穿 10 個洞，然後把游泳圈（西林瓶）浸入有顏色的水（亞甲藍），並且製造負壓（像在拉游泳圈上的開口），看看有色水會不會滲入。如果沒有藍色，代表橡膠的自癒合（self-sealing）能力夠強，能在多次穿刺後依然保持屏障。
blocks.en: The self-sealing test is like checking whether a swim ring (the rubber) still holds water after being pierced many times. You pierce 10 holes with a needle, then immerse the swim ring (the vial) in colored water (methylene blue) and create negative pressure (like pulling on the opening of the ring) to see whether the colored water seeps in. If no blue is found, the rubber's self-sealing capacity is strong enough to keep the barrier intact after repeated punctures.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 廠接受預充式注射器客戶時，活塞（plunger）的穿刺性測試通常不適用（活塞不被針頭穿刺），但碎屑問題仍然存在於組裝和推注過程。應重點評估：（1）活塞在注射力 (glide force) 下的矽油膜穩定性；（2）針頭護套 (needle shield) 的穿刺力；（3）多劑量藥瓶 (multi-dose vial) 的橡膠塞則需完整執行全部三項功能試驗。
blocks.en: When a CDMO accepts a prefilled syringe client, the penetrability test for the plunger is usually not applicable (the plunger is not pierced by a needle), but fragments can still arise during assembly and injection. The assessment should focus on: (1) the stability of the silicone oil film on the plunger under glide force; (2) the penetration force of the needle shield; and (3) for stoppers of multi-dose vials, all three functionality tests must be performed in full.

blocks.zh: 如果一個橡膠塞碎屑試驗結果顯示 8 個可見碎屑，超過限量。你應如何調查原因？哪些因素可能導致過多碎屑？
blocks.en: If a stopper's fragmentation test shows 8 visible fragments, exceeding the limit, how should you investigate the cause? Which factors could lead to excessive fragments?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Self-Sealing Capacity 試驗只針對多劑量容器（multiple-dose containers），而不包括單劑量西林瓶？
blocks.en: Why is the Self-Sealing Capacity test applied only to multiple-dose containers and not to single-dose vials?

blocks.zh: 穿刺力試驗要求每個瓶塞都用一根新針頭（using a new needle for each closure）。如果重複使用同一根針頭會如何？
blocks.en: The penetrability test requires a new needle for each closure (using a new needle for each closure). What would happen if the same needle were reused?

blocks.zh: 〈381〉 完整試驗要求矩陣
blocks.en: Complete Test Requirements Matrix for <381>

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 生物反應性試驗：先做 〈87〉 體外試驗（細胞毒性），不符合才做 〈88〉 體內試驗；Type I 和 Type II 使用相同標準。但 〈381〉 僅提供基線信息，高風險藥品必須與監管機構溝通，並完成 〈1663〉/〈1664〉 深度研究
blocks.en: Biological reactivity tests: perform the <87> in vitro test (cytotoxicity) first, and only if it fails, the <88> in vivo test; Type I and Type II use the same criteria. However, <381> provides only baseline information, and for high-risk drug products you must consult regulators and complete the in-depth <1663>/<1664> studies

blocks.zh: 穿刺性試驗（10 個瓶 × 1 次穿刺）：≤10 N；碎屑試驗（12 個瓶 × 5 次穿刺，合併過濾）：≤5 個可見碎屑（>50 µm）
blocks.en: Penetrability test (10 vials × 1 puncture): ≤10 N; fragmentation test (12 vials × 5 punctures, pooled filtration): ≤5 visible fragments (>50 µm)

blocks.zh: 自密封試驗（10 個瓶 × 10 次穿刺，浸入 0.1% 亞甲藍 + 27 kPa 負壓）：所有瓶均無藍色滲入；此試驗僅適用於多劑量容器
blocks.en: Self-sealing test (10 vials × 10 punctures, immersed in 0.1% methylene blue + 27 kPa negative pressure): no blue penetration in any vial; this test applies only to multiple-dose containers

blocks.zh: 功能試驗使用標準化針頭（21G，bevel 12±2°），試驗樣品需先按樣品溶液制備步驟處理並乾燥，確保測試條件的代表性
blocks.en: The functionality tests use a standardized needle (21G, bevel 12±2°), and test samples must first be treated and dried following the sample solution preparation procedure, ensuring representative test conditions
